name: Terque (Spain)
description: Horizontally divided blue over green in the proportions 1:2, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Terque (grapes on yellow above waves, inscribed TERQUE 1571).
history: Municipal flag of Terque; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Terque arms — grapes above waves, inscribed
